topicName: Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Sentinel
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Integrating Microsoft Defender for Cloud with Microsoft Sentinel"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"This tutorial guides you through connecting Microsoft Defender for Cloud to Microsoft Sentinel in Azure. By integrating these two services, you can centralize your security posture management and threat detection capabilities."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"An active Azure subscription with Microsoft Defender for Cloud enabled on your resources."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A Log Analytics workspace configured to act as your Microsoft Sentinel workspace."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Contributor or Security Administrator permissions on the subscription and workspace."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on your Workspace"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"Before streaming alerts, ensure that Microsoft Sentinel is active on your target Log Analytics workspace via the Azure Portal or using Azure CLI."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"az monitor log-analytics workspace create --resource-group \"mySecurityRG\" --workspace-name \"mySentinelWorkspace\""},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Connect Defender for Cloud to Microsoft Sentinel"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Navigate to the Microsoft Sentinel service in the Azure Portal, select your workspace, and open the Data Connectors blade. Search for \"Microsoft Defender for Cloud\" and click \"Open connector page\"."},{"order":12,"type":"paragraph","text":"Configure the subscription you wish to connect and click \"Connect\". This establishes the data stream for security alerts and recommendations."},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Verify Data Ingestion"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"To verify that security alerts are successfully flowing into Microsoft Sentinel, run a Kusto Query Language (KQL) query in the Logs section of your workspace."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"SecurityAlert\n| where ProviderName == \"MCAS\" or ProviderName == \"Azure Security Center\"\n| summarize count() by AlertName, TimeGenerated"},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":17,"type":"paragraph","text":"You have successfully integrated Microsoft Defender for Cloud with Microsoft Sentinel. You can now build custom analytics rules, automate incident response using playbooks, and leverage advanced hunting queries across your cloud estate."}]
